comments.content: Passing `&nt->forced_track` here clears an explicitly supplied `forced` flag because `mp_guess_lang_from_filename()` initializes its output to false. Thus `sub-add foo.srt forced` loses the flag whenever the demuxer provides no language and the filename lacks a `.forced` suffix. Parse into temporary booleans and OR the inferred values into the existing track flags (likewise preserving `hearing_impaired_track`).
